scenarios.name: Cancel a staged model-state parameter column and value

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has a part with three model-state members
an extrusion has a length parameter d0 of 1 in
the model-state table does not include d0
the user opens the model-state table
selects d0 under the extrusion on the Parameters tab
transfers d0 to the chosen parameters
the grid has a d0 column showing 1 in for each member
the user changes the Copy State d0 cell to 2 in
the other two d0 cells display 1 in
the user cancels and reopens the model-state table
d0 is absent from the chosen parameters
the grid has no d0 column
